title: Figure 4: H. G. Wells's The Invisible Man book cover – Invisibility by Transparency
description: Image of a Signet Classic paperback cover of H. G. Wells's "The Invisible Man," showing a black bowler hat floating above an empty suit, shirt and red tie with no visible head. The caption reads "Figure 4. H. G. Wells's The Invisible Man: Invisibility by Transparency." The text discusses refractive index and transparency as a route to invisibility.
